result.title: MAMath-Bench: Process-Aware and Robust Evaluation of Multimodal Multi-Agent Mathematical Reasoning
result.summary: Mathematical reasoning is a fundamental capability for educational applications of Large Language Models (LLMs), where reliable problem solving requires not only correct answers but also coherent and verifiable reasoning processes. Multi-agent systems (MASs) have shown growing potential in this domain by leveraging collaboration and verification among multiple LLM agents. However, existing evaluations primarily focus on the correctness of final answers in text-only settings, offering limited insight into multimodal reasoning capabilities, the reliability of intermediate reasoning steps, and robustness against reasoning errors. To address these limitations, we introduce MAMath-Bench, a process-aware benchmark designed to evaluate the multimodal mathematical reasoning capabilities of MASs. MAMath-Bench comprises 1,003 problems spanning 11 mathematical categories, multiple difficulty levels, and several modalities, including text, images, and audio. It features fine-grained milestone annotations to evaluate systems across three dimensions: problem-solving correctness, reasoning-process reliability, and robustness to adversarial reasoning-chain perturbations. Our evaluation yields three key findings. First, multi-agent collaboration does not consistently improve final-answer accuracy over strong single LLMs. Second, collaboration can substantially enhance the coverage of intermediate reasoning, but such gains may come at the cost of increased reasoning redundancy. Third, current systems remain vulnerable to adversarial reasoning errors, particularly those involving subtle structural perturbations. The dataset is available at https://github.com/mira-ai-lab/AgentMath.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MAMath-Bench，一个面向多智能体系统的多模态数学推理基准，含 1003 道覆盖 11 类、多难度与文本/图像/音频模态的题目，并用细粒度里程碑标注从答案正确性、推理过程可靠性和对推理链扰动的鲁棒性三维度评估。实验发现多智能体协作未必提升答案准确率，可提高中间推理覆盖但带来冗余，且系统对细微结构性扰动仍脆弱。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于多模态推理的过程级诊断与基准，其里程碑式过程标注和对抗扰动评估可供核查 LVR 中中间状态可信度、贡献分配与冗余/计算成本的衡量方式，但未涉及 latent 状态本身。
